evals.prompt: How do we get our product recommended by ChatGPT when people ask for the best project management tool for agencies?
evals.expected_output: Prompt-set baseline, owned content fixes, off-site source gaps, technical access, measurement.
assertions: Proposes a prompt set to baseline
Defines AI share of voice metric

evals.prompt: Rewrite this section so LLMs are more likely to quote it: [section].
evals.expected_output: Answer-first, specific, reader-first rewrite without artificial chunking.

evals.prompt: Should we add an llms.txt file and chunk our blog posts for AI?
evals.expected_output: Explains Google's guidance that neither is needed; llms.txt only useful for dev docs/agents.
assertions: Says Google Search doesn't use llms.txt
Redirects to fundamentals and original content

evals.prompt: Build a prompt set to track our AI search visibility. Our root terms are 'expense management' and 'corporate card'.
evals.expected_output: Runs each root term through AnswerThePublic (or asks the user to), sorts fan-outs into buckets, filters and rewrites them into natural prompts, adds brand and competitor prompts, ends with 25-50 prompts.
assertions: Uses AnswerThePublic with each root term the user gave
Sorts questions, prepositions, and comparisons into prompt buckets
Rewrites search fragments into full conversational questions
Filters out results outside the ICP
